head.title: SQL Island - The Tool Belt
head.teaser: After an emergency landing, Nova must rebuild the lost tool belt using ARRAY operations.
head.author: Kanhaiya Kanhaiya

manipulate-scene.text:
Nova and Archivist Lyra open the Adventurers’ Guild database to investigate the malfunction in the escape system. Lyra explains that each adventurer’s equipment is stored in an array column called inventory.
Before they can locate the parts needed for the shuttle, they must first inspect the database.
Task: Display all rows and columns from the table players.

Nova wants to know how many tools each adventurer is carrying.
Task: Display each player and the number of tools in their inventory.
manipulate-scene.sql-solution: SELECT name, array_length(inventory,1) AS tool_count FROM players;
manipulate-scene.sql-check: SELECT name, array_length(inventory,1) AS tool_count FROM players;

manipulate-scene.text:
Nova searches for a toolkit to begin repairs.
Task: Find players whose inventory contains 'toolkit'.
manipulate-scene.sql-solution: SELECT name FROM players WHERE inventory @> ARRAY['toolkit'];
manipulate-scene.sql-check: SELECT name FROM players WHERE inventory @> ARRAY['toolkit'];

manipulate-scene.text:
Nova lays out all tools on the beach to organize them.
Task: Unnest all inventories so each tool appears as a separate row.
manipulate-scene.sql-solution: SELECT name, unnest(inventory) AS tool FROM players;
manipulate-scene.sql-check: SELECT name, unnest(inventory) AS tool FROM players;

manipulate-scene.text:
Nova picks up a repair kit and adds it to the tool belt.
Task: Add 'repair_kit' to Borin's inventory.
manipulate-scene.sql-solution: UPDATE players SET inventory = array_append(inventory,'repair_kit') WHERE name='Borin';
manipulate-scene.sql-check: UPDATE players SET inventory = array_append(inventory,'repair_kit') WHERE name='Borin';

manipulate-scene.text:
Nova finds multiple tools together and adds them at once.
Task: Add 'engine_part' and 'toolkit' to Darius's inventory.
manipulate-scene.sql-solution: UPDATE players SET inventory = inventory || ARRAY['engine_part','toolkit'] WHERE name='Darius';
manipulate-scene.sql-check: UPDATE players SET inventory = inventory || ARRAY['engine_part','toolkit'] WHERE name='Darius';

manipulate-scene.text:
Some tools are broken and must be removed from the tool belt.
Task: Remove 'fuel_cell' from Aria's inventory.
manipulate-scene.sql-solution: UPDATE players SET inventory = array_remove(inventory,'fuel_cell') WHERE name='Aria';
manipulate-scene.sql-check: UPDATE players SET inventory = array_remove(inventory,'fuel_cell') WHERE name='Aria';

manipulate-scene.text:
Nova upgrades an old tool with a better one.
Task: Replace 'oxygen_tank' with 'advanced_oxygen_tank' in Ciri's inventory.
manipulate-scene.sql-solution: UPDATE players SET inventory = array_replace(inventory,'oxygen_tank','advanced_oxygen_tank') WHERE name='Ciri';
manipulate-scene.sql-check: UPDATE players SET inventory = array_replace(inventory,'oxygen_tank','advanced_oxygen_tank') WHERE name='Ciri';

manipulate-scene.text:
Nova needs players who already have all essential tools.
Task: Find players whose inventory contains 'engine_part', 'toolkit', and 'repair_kit'.
manipulate-scene.sql-solution: SELECT name FROM players WHERE inventory @> ARRAY['engine_part','toolkit','repair_kit'];
manipulate-scene.sql-check: SELECT name FROM players WHERE inventory @> ARRAY['engine_part','toolkit','repair_kit'];

manipulate-scene.text:
Nova reviews the completed tool belt to ensure everything is ready for repair.
Task: Display all players and their final inventories.
